title: GM Construction Assistance & Low-Friction Spatial Authoring
objective: Provide recognize/suggest/confirm workflows for rooms, boundaries, openings, paths and structural roles; include fast manual correction, reusable construction kits and unusual-space authoring while keeping uncertain recognition and generated assistance proposal-first until confirmed and preserving canonical MAI, ISE, Scene, Asset, Permission and completed-SSA ownership.

persistence.reason: SSA-07 adds bounded recognition, proposal, correction, kit and unusual-space authoring semantics over existing SSA, Scene, Asset and permission identities; it does not establish a new canonical construction or owner ledger.

preserved_boundaries: SSA-01 through SSA-06 remain completed_verified with retired implementation authority.

MAI remains canonical for map/visual asset interoperability and completed ISE remains canonical for the native playable Scene surface; Scene, Asset, Permission/entitlement and provider/media-rights owners remain authoritative.
Generated recognize/suggest results and uncertain structural inference remain assistance until confirmed where certainty is insufficient.
Fast manual correction and reusable construction kits cannot bypass owner validation, permissions or canonical domain authority.
Pixels, visual adjacency and image recognition output cannot become structural or semantic truth by themselves.
Hidden/GM-only construction semantics and protected cardinality remain filtered before player/accessibility/diagnostic/export/AI projection.
Accessible nonvisual authoring and correction equivalents remain required for consequential actions.
No durable SSA-07 persistence change is required and migration 0022 remains unreserved.
SSA-08+, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
